## RecCheck 1.0 — first public release

Nightly POS receipt audit for the protel checkcharge1 report (.oxps). Everything runs locally — no data leaves the machine.

### Install

Download **RecCheck-Setup.exe** below (under *Assets*) and open it. It installs in a few seconds — no administrator password — and puts **RecCheck** on the Desktop and in the Start Menu.

If Windows shows a blue *"Windows protected your PC"* screen: click **More info → Run anyway** (the app is unsigned, not harmful).

From then on the app updates itself: when a new version exists, a blue ↑ button appears bottom-right inside the app — one click installs it.

### Highlights

Per-department receipt checklists with per-day state · receipt search by serial · VOID detection for consolidated receipts · OPEN pill for departments not yet closed · watchlist with yellow compare-closely highlighting · persistent room database with searchable nicknames that reset when guests change · printable Greek corrections sheet · parse self-verification on every load.
